normalization_plan.reason: The fact parameter is a simple lookup key merged into its consumer function isValid.
The factHash parameter is only used to index the verifiedFact mapping inside registerFact.
proofParams is consumed directly by verifyProof for parameter validation.
proof is consumed by verifyProof and passed to the channel as a pointer.
publicInput is consumed by verifyProof and its helpers, so it folds into that function.
n only bounds the loop inside MerkleVerifier.verify.
queuePtr is an internal memory pointer used solely within MerkleVerifier.verify.
channelPtr is an internal memory pointer used solely within MerkleVerifier.verify.
root is compared against the computed hash at the end of MerkleVerifier.verify.
The local ctx array is the central data structure of verifyProof and its callees.
The local friQueue pointer is only used inside friVerifyLayers.
proofOfWorkBits is only used to compute the threshold in verifyProofOfWork.
